[S6] Zand, MD, PhD Professor of Medicine University of Rochester Medical Center 601 Elmwood Ave – Box 675 Rochester, NY 14642 Vox: 585.275.4517 Fax: 585.486.1043 E-mail: Martin_Zand@urmc.rochester.edu Supplementary Figure 1 FACS-sort gating Normal human memory B cells were CFSE-stained and cultured with CpG ODN, IL-2, IL-10, IL-15 and BAFF for 96 hours. [S7] The cells were stained with Live/Dead Violet, anti-CD19-PE-Cy5 and anti-CD27-APC-H7. [S8] The above strategy was used for FACS-sorting, first performing doublet exclusion, then gating on CD19+ cells, and finally sorting cells into three populations based upon CD27 expression and CFSE staining: Undivided, CD27hi proliferating, and CD27lo proliferating cells. [S9] Greater than 95% of cells were typically found to be CD19+. [S10] While CD19 levels decreased with proliferation,this did not affect the sorted subpopulations. [S14] Zand 96.5 50K 150K 250K 51.7 98.6 98.6 94.8 0 50K 150K 250K FSC-A 0 50K 150K 250K FSC-W 50K 150K 250K Live/Dead Violet CD19-PE-Cy5 Cell # SSC-A FSC-H SSC-H SSC-A 50K 100K 150K 200K 250K 50K 150K 250K 50K 150K 250K SSC-W CFSE CD19-PECy5 CFSE CD27-APC-H7 96.5 anti-CD27 FMO Control und CD27lo CD27hi a CD3G RQ b CD27hi CD27lo Und CD27 CD3G CD4 CD8B CD5 CD14 B2M CD8A Undivided CD27lo CD27hi 1 2 3 4 5 6 1 2 3 4 5 6 1 2 3 4 5 6 Log2 Values -2 -1 Supplementary Figure S2: Relative Expression Levels of Control Genes. [S15] (a) Gene expression data (row normalized) from Affymetrix gene arrays of human memory B cells FACS-sorted based on anti-CD27 and CFSE staining show expected levels of CD27 expression (n=6 subjects in 3 separate experiments). [S16] Little evidence is seen of mRNA for markers of T cells, naive B cells or monocytic cell types. [S17] (b) Lack of expression of the T cell marker CD3 was confirmed by qRT-PCR (n=10 subjects, including 6 used for gene array). [S18] The square indicates the median RQ value. [S19] Cq values were normalized to toal RNA content using 18S RNA and re-normalized to the mean of 4 control genes. [S20] A paired t-test was used to compare qRT-PCR data. [S21] Data sets containing negative (zero) values were analyzed with an independent t-test. [S22] One CD27hi sample did show a high RQ value, but this was not seen in the gene array data of the same sample, neither in gene array nor qRT-PCR data from the other cell subsets from the same sample and so was deemed spurious. S1:Significantly Differentially Expressed Genes CD27hi:CD27lo At 96 hours of stimulation with CpG plus a combination of cytokines (IL-2, IL-10, IL-15; CpG + CK), CD19+ human mBc were sorted by CD27 expression and a CFSE-stain for proliferation. [S27] Gene expression of three sorted cells was analyzed with Affymetrix U133 human microarrays. [S28] Using a paired SAM analysis at an FDR=0.03, 2,771 probe sets (2,033 genes) were significantly different between CD27hi and CD27lo proliferating human mBc.
